source_evidence: 12 Grassroots Democracy – Part 3 CHAPTER Local Government in Urban Areas I desire that … a full-fledged local body should be immediately formed, … so that people may know really what is an administration, what are the franchise, what are the powers, what are the rights and what are the privileges in a small sphere, in their own town, in their own villages.
Sidhwa, Member, Constituent Assembly (during the Constituent Assembly Debates, 13 October 1949) Fig.
The Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (originally ‘Bombay Municipal Corporation’) was created in 1865.
What are urban local bodies The Big and what are their functions?
